about: Where each file of the blackjack engine (src/engine/) comes from. Two hops: Scoutgaming -> Dealer game/ -> here. Ported files keep Scout's logic; a token-level diff of each type-stripped port against its Scout blob (whitespace and parentheses ignored) shows only the deviations listed here. Re-check when Scout changes: git -C <scoutgaming> rev-parse <commit>:<path> must still equal blob.

scout.commitNote: origin/main 2026-11-11; the same blobs are unchanged at main 76acbcd9d

copiedFrom.workingTree: clean: `git status --short game tools` was empty before and after the copy, and git hash-object of each of the 18 copied files equalled <commit>:<path> before any edit here
copiedFrom.engine: The ten src/engine/<name>.ts files are byte-identical to Dealer game/<name>.ts at that commit. tsc --noEmit under this project's strict tsconfig needed no change. Re-check: git hash-object src/engine/<name>.ts must equal git -C <dealer> rev-parse <commit>:game/<name>.ts.
copiedFrom.provenance: This file is Dealer game/provenance.json with `game/` paths rewritten to `src/engine/`, `about` extended and this block added. The Scout blobs and deviations in `ported` and `new` are Dealer's record, unchanged.

tests.all: Seven behaviour tests, renamed tools/game-<name>.test.ts -> src/engine/<name>.test.ts. In each: import specifiers `../game/<x>.ts` -> `./<x>.ts`, and the header comment's `game/<x>.ts` -> `src/engine/<x>.ts`. No test case removed, skipped or reworded.

files.changes: see all; plus the three paths of its two file-reading tests: gameDir is the test's own folder (`'../game'` -> `'.'`), the provenance test expects and strips the prefix `src/engine/` (was `game/`), and both folder listings skip `*.test.ts` because the tests now sit in the folder they scan (in Dealer they sat in tools/). It reads only this folder: the engine files and this provenance.json
